findings.title: disableTypography drops MuiListItemText-primary/secondary class hooks
findings.body: MUI ListItemText normally applies .MuiListItemText-primary/.MuiListItemText-secondary via the auto-generated Typography wrapper. disableTypography removes those wrappers. Repo grep of ui-dashboard for MuiListItemText returned zero dependents. Accepted: theoretical future-theme/e2e risk only.

findings.body: Source-text disableTypography/token substring checks are unscoped. Rendered-DOM and computed-style tests already provide the real regression coverage. Not blocking.
